During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] conducted a '''mission''' to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]] to rescue [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] of [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], who had been [[Mission to Bardotta/Legends|kidnapped]] by the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]].
